title: Chemical Probe Discovery for DEAD-box RNA Binding Protein DDX21 using Small Molecule Microarrays
authors: Toshihiko Aiba; Eliezer Calo; Angela N. Koehler
one_liner_zh: 该文通过小分子微阵列筛选发现靶向RNA结合蛋白DDX21的化学探针，虽涉及蛋白-RNA互作抑制，但对象为RNA结合蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，且方法为实验筛选而非AI或物理模拟，仅间接相关。
abstract: The DEAD-box family of ATPases plays a critical role in nearly all stages of RNA metabolism, from transcription to degradation, and serves as a major regulator of biomolecular condensates. Dysregulation of DEAD-box proteins is well established in a variety of diseases, including cancer and neurodegenerative disorders, making them attractive therapeutic targets. However, their classification as “undruggable” has historically hindered small molecule-based modulation. In this study, we focus on DDX21, a member of the DEAD-box family involved in ribosome biogenesis and transcriptional regulation. As a proof of concept for targeting such RNA-binding proteins, we developed a lysate-based small molecule microarray platform to identify compounds that directly bind DDX21. This screen led to the discovery of KI-DX-014, a small molecule compound capable of inhibiting DDX21 interaction with RNA. KI-DX-014 modulated RNA-dependent functions of DDX21, including its ATPase activity and biomolecular condensate formation. Furthermore, KI-DX-014 attenuated the DDX21-dependent release of P-TEFb from the 7SK snRNP complex in vitro, suppressed P-TEFb-dependent phosphorylation of the RNA polymerase II CTD, and induced developmental defects in zebrafish embryos. These findings reveal a previously unexploited therapeutic avenue and establish KI-DX-014 as a valuable chemical probe for dissecting the biological functions of DDX21 in both normal physiology and disease states.
abstract_zh: DEAD-box家族ATPase在RNA代谢的几乎所有阶段（从转录到降解）中发挥关键作用，并作为生物分子凝聚体的主要调节因子。DEAD-box蛋白的失调已在多种疾病中得到充分证实，包括癌症和神经退行性疾病，使其成为有吸引力的治疗靶点。然而，它们被归类为“不可成药”的特性历来阻碍了基于小分子的调控。在本研究中，我们聚焦于DDX21，这是DEAD-box家族中参与核糖体生物发生和转录调控的一员。作为靶向此类RNA结合蛋白的概念验证，我们开发了一种基于裂解物的小分子微阵列平台，以识别直接结合DDX21的化合物。该筛选发现了KI-DX-014，一种能够抑制DDX21与RNA相互作用的小分子化合物。KI-DX-014调节了DDX21的RNA依赖性功能，包括其ATPase活性和生物分子凝聚体形成。此外，KI-DX-014在体外减弱了DDX21依赖性的P-TEFb从7SK snRNP复合物中的释放，抑制了P-TEFb依赖性的RNA聚合酶II CTD磷酸化，并在斑马鱼胚胎中诱导了发育缺陷。这些发现揭示了一条此前未被开发的治疗途径，并将KI-DX-014确立为一种有价值的化学探针，用于解析DDX21在正常生理和疾病状态中的生物学功能。
